_comment: Example config for a Bay-Area / remote Senior+ Product Design job search, with two bonus families (design management, and Product Manager roles in a specific niche) showing off every gate type. Copy this file, rename it, and edit the regexes to match YOUR target role, seniority, and geography. See README.md 'Customizing your config' for a field-by-field walkthrough.

geography._comment: Role-location gating, applied to every family. A role's location string must match include_regex. If it ALSO matches foreign_regex it's dropped unless it ALSO matches us_override_regex. Delete this whole 'geography' block to disable location filtering entirely (e.g. for a fully-remote-anywhere search).

role_families.label: Senior/Staff/Principal Product Design (individual contributor)
role_families._comment: 'primary': true means this family also drives the shared Match_Confidence / Source_Method / Web_Search_Needed columns.
role_families.include_regex: product design|ux design|ux researcher|ui/ux|interaction design|design system|experience design|product designer|ux designer

theme_gate._comment: Only active per-company when the CSV row's 'enabled_when_column' cell is non-blank. Useful for large diversified companies where you only want roles in a specific org (e.g. a company that makes many products, but you only want its developer-tools division). Leave the column blank for any company where you'll accept any matching role.
theme_gate.keywords_regex: developer experience|developer platform|developer productivity|developer tool|\bdevex\b|\bdx\b|observability|monitoring|telemetry|\bAPM\b|logging|tracing|internal tool|internal platform|platform engineering|infrastructure|employee experience|enterprise tool|admin

role_families.label: Design people-manager roles requiring < 5 years of management experience
role_families.include_regex: design manager|manager,?\s*(of\s+)?(product\s+|ux\s+|experience\s+|visual\s+)?design|head of\s+(product\s+|ux\s+)?design|director,?\s*(of\s+)?(product\s+|ux\s+)?design|design director|ux manager|manager,?\s*ux|group design manager|manager,?\s*(of\s+)?user experience|head of user experience

years_experience_gate._comment: Parses the job description for the smallest 'N years' figure sitting near a management-related term, and DROPS the role if that figure is >= max_years. A description that never states a management-years requirement is KEPT and marked 'unspecified' (no-false-negatives — you verify manually).

role_families.label: Product Manager roles in observability / BI / developer-experience
role_families.include_regex: \bproduct manager\b|\bproduct management\b|group product manager|head of product\b|director,?\s*(of\s+)?product\b|\bproduct lead\b|\bproduct owner\b
role_families.exclude_regex: \bproduct design\b|product marketing|program manager|project manager|engineer|\bdesigner\b|\bassociate\b|\bjunior\b|\bjr\.?\b|intern\b|new grad|entry level|partner manager|account manager|community|sales|recruit

theme_gate._comment: 'always' means this gate applies to every company, not just ones with a CSV flag set. A role counts if its title/department matches keywords_regex, OR if the company itself is 'native' to the theme (its taxonomy columns match native_company_regex) — at a company whose whole product IS observability, a plain 'Senior Product Manager' is on-theme by construction.
theme_gate.keywords_regex: observability|monitoring|telemetry|\bAPM\b|log management|logging|tracing|incident|on-?call|\bSRE\b|reliability|business intelligence|\bBI\b|analytics|data visuali[sz]ation|dashboard|metrics|semantic layer|data warehouse|\bETL\b|data platform|reporting|developer experience|developer platform|developer productivity|developer tool|\bdevex\b|\bDX\b|platform engineering|internal tool|API platform|\bSDK\b|integrations|build system|\bCI/?CD\b
theme_gate.native_company_regex: observability|monitoring|business intelligence|\bBI\b|analytics|semantic layer|data infrastructure|data & ai|developer experience|api platforms|internal tooling|app dev
